source.title: WCA Lead Organizer Overview & Pilot (November 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community, 

The WCA is introducing a [Lead Organizer (LO) Requirements Policy](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QRRmHDWm3MYl5cb0m63jsbjAVa3BausUny9G-pDZLBE/edit?tab=t.0), to improve financial transparency, reduce legal risk, and support the long-term growth of competitive speedcubing. The model formalizes responsibility for WCA competitions, including the finances, venue, organization, and competition management.
<!-- break -->
Implementation will be phased, beginning with a pilot in regions ready to adopt the model. The pilot will help test processes and identify areas for improvement, with full implementation targeted for Q3 2027. The long-term goal is for every competition to have exactly one Lead Organizer.

**Pilot Scope**
The following areas, confirmed with Senior Delegates, will participate in the initial pilot:
• Canada
• Oceania
• United Kingdom
• United States

Competitions for the above areas must have an accredited Lead Organizer for any competitions announced on or after January 1, 2027. 

**Application Process**
Any organization or individual that organizes WCA competitions may apply, as long as they meet the requirements for a Lead Organizer. 
	[Lead Organizer Application - Organization](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5YsHGupbkjCjRobgdmSz-zAFVOxyqiI1oA9fWitcYeyj0WA/viewform?usp=header)
	[Lead Organizer Application - Individual](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_kDlkISTMh3mg5QZlSzqhJrBO3hXgKo3DsO4r20fPW2ec3w/viewform?usp=header)

**Applications for pilot areas must be received by December 11, 2026**. We will continue to process new Lead Organizer applications after that date, but accredited Lead Organizers will become mandatory for pilot areas for all competitions announced on or after January 1, 2027. 
Once an application has been submitted, applicants can expect a response within approximately three weeks. 
Please direct any questions about potential eligibility to become a Lead Organizer to your WCA Delegate or Regional Organization.

translation.title: WCA 主办负责人制度概述与试点（2026 年 11 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 正在推行[主办负责人（Lead Organizer，LO）要求政策](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QRRmHDWm3MYl5cb0m63jsbjAVa3BausUny9G-pDZLBE/edit?tab=t.0)，以提高财务透明度、降低法律风险，并支持竞技速拧的长期发展。这一模式将正式明确 WCA 比赛相关事务的责任，包括财务、场地、组织和比赛管理。

实施工作将分阶段进行，首先在已准备好采用这一模式的地区开展试点。试点将用于检验流程并找出需要改进之处，目标是在 2027 年第三季度全面实施。长期目标是让每场比赛都有且仅有一个主办负责人。

**试点范围**

经与高级代表确认，以下地区将参加首轮试点：

- 加拿大
- 大洋洲
- 英国
- 美国

上述地区在 2027 年 1 月 1 日或之后公示的所有比赛，都必须有经过认证的主办负责人。

**申请流程**

任何举办 WCA 比赛的机构或个人，只要符合主办负责人的要求，都可以申请。

- [主办负责人申请表：机构](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd5YsHGupbkjCjRobgdmSz-zAFVOxyqiI1oA9fWitcYeyj0WA/viewform?usp=header)
- [主办负责人申请表：个人](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_kDlkISTMh3mg5QZlSzqhJrBO3hXgKo3DsO4r20fPW2ec3w/viewform?usp=header)

**试点地区的申请必须在 2026 年 12 月 11 日前送达。** 此后我们仍会继续处理新的主办负责人申请，但试点地区在 2027 年 1 月 1 日或之后公示的所有比赛，都必须有经过认证的主办负责人。

提交申请后，申请人预计将在约三周内收到回复。

如对自己是否有资格成为主办负责人有任何疑问，请咨询你的 WCA 代表或地区组织。
notes: Lead Organizer 在当前可检索的官方中文术语中未命中；本译文采用“主办负责人”，并在首次出现时保留英文名称和 LO 缩写。原文明确机构或个人均可申请。
